text:
alex: Quick heads-up — final cut for v1.27.0 is in ~8 hours. We need the version bump PR merged, changelog entry, docs publish, and security sign-off before cutoff. Linking checklist and the open PRs below.

alex: PRs:
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412 (version bump + changelog)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289 (docs: new routing policy docs)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/998 (kv cache fix)

alex: Quick commands if helpful:
```bash
# bump and push
git checkout -b release/v1.27.0
./scripts/bump-version 1.27.0
git commit -am "bump v1.27.0"
git push origin release/v1.27.0
```

jamie: On it — I left a minor comment on the docs PR about an example snippet. Will resolve within the hour.

ravi: CI for runtime PR is green except flaky perf-test-rc. Kicking a retry now. If it passes I'll merge.

megan: Security review: I reviewed the changes in platform PR. No secrets added, lgtm pending one nit about logging verbosity. Marking as approved in ticket. Will add formal sign-off comment shortly.

alex: Thanks megan. Can you paste the short sign-off comment here when done so I can include in release notes?

megan: Approved for release — no sensitive surface changes and logs set to info. Adding comment: "security review complete — no findings" :white_check_mark:

jamie: Docs PR updated and example fixed. Preview build passed. Manual spot-check on the routing examples looks good.

ravi: Runtime CI rerun passed, merging now. 998 -> merged.

alex: Great. Once platform PR is merged we should tag and create release draft. Who's comfortable cutting the tag? I can do it after the docs build finishes.

sara: I can cut the tag if you want me to. I'll wait for your go. Also will kick the smoke suite once tag is up.

alex: Please cut the tag, thanks. Steps:
1) merge platform PR
2) tag v1.27.0 and push
3) release-bot will publish draft (should include changelog snippet from PR)
4) smoke tests run, then we merge docs PR to main and trigger docs publish

release-bot: release-draft created for v1.27.0 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/releases/tag/v1.27.0-draft

sara: Tag pushed: git push origin refs/tags/v1.27.0. Kicking smoke tests now.

jamie: Docs merged to main after smoke pass. Preview published at https://docs.redwood.com/v1.27.0/ (gave it a quick check)

ravi: Smoke tests — all green except one perf regression on long-context throughput (down ~6%). Flagged in tracking ticket: https://app.internal/issue/RELEASE-143. It's below our threshold but logged.

alex: Noted. Because it's under 10% we proceed but add a follow-up to Optimize for next patch. I've added RELEASE-144 to backlog.

megan: Formal security sign-off comment added to platform PR and release draft.

sara: Merge checklist complete. Tag live, smoke green, docs published, security signed. Anything else blocking?

jamie: Quick ask — can we call out the kv-cache perf note in the release notes under Known Issues? I can add a short blurb.

alex: Yes please add it. Keep it short: "Observed ~6% throughput regression for long-context workloads after kv-cache change; under investigation. Not expected to affect typical short-sequence services."

jamie: Added to release draft.

ravi: One more small thing — I've pinged infra to monitor deployment latency for first 2 hours post-release.

alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll close the thread once the draft is published and we confirm the release page is public. :thumbsup:

release-bot: release v1.27.0 published — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/releases/tag/v1.27.0

alex: Closing — great work all.
